title: AI-Powered IPsec VPN Protocol Analyzer and Security Assessment Framework
description:
• Background Virtual Private Networks (VPNs) are fundamental to secure communication over untrusted networks. Among the available VPN technologies, IPsec is widely adopted across enterprise, government, military, and cloud infrastructures because of its ability to provide confidentiality, integrity and authentication.
However, the security of an IPsec deployment depends on multiple factors, including the chosen cryptographic algorithms, authentication mechanisms, key exchange protocols, and operational mode (Tunnel or Transport). Misconfigurations, outdated cipher suites, improper key management, or protocol implementation flaws can significantly weaken the overall security posture.
Traditional protocol analysis tools provide packet-level visibility but often require expert interpretation. There is a growing need for intelligent systems capable of automatically analyzing IPsec deployments, identifying protocol characteristics, assessing security risks, and generating actionable recommendations.
• Description: Design and develop an AI-driven protocol analysis platform capable of automatically analysing IPsec VPN deployments established under different security configurations. The platform should inspect captured traffic or live network streams, identify protocol characteristics, infer VPN operating modes, evaluate cryptographic configurations and generate an automated security assessment report.
The solution should assist analysts in understanding the security posture of IPsec deployments without requiring manual packet inspection. Participants are expected to develop an intelligent framework capable of performing the following tasks.
a) VPN Testbed Generation: Develop a laboratory environment capable of establishing IPsec VPNs using multiple configurations. The framework should support variations such as:
• Tunnel Mode
• Transport Mode
• AES-128
• AES-256
• AES-GCM
• AES-CBC + HMAC
• Different DH Groups
• Perfect Forward Secrecy enabled/disabled
• IPv4 and IPv6 communication
• Different types of traffic – VoIP, Whatsapp, E-mail, Web-browsing, ICMP, Video streaming etc.
b) Traffic Capture: Acquire network traces using tools such as Wireshark, TCP-dump, Custom packet capture utilities. Captured dataset should include
• IKE negotiation
• ESP packets
• AH packets (optional)
• Normal communication c) AI-Based Protocol Identification: Develop an AI engine capable of automatically identifying
• IPsec protocol
• IKE version
• Tunnel Mode
• Transport Mode
• Encryption algorithm
• Authentication algorithm
• Key exchange method
• Security Association characteristics
• Predict Type of traffic inside ESP-IPsec d) Security Assessment: The framework should automatically evaluate
• Cryptographic strength
• Configuration compliance
• Security Association parameters
• Key lifetime
• Replay protection
• Forward Secrecy configuration
• Cipher suite strength
• Metadata exposure e) The output should include a comprehensive security score, traffic analysis and metadata inference. Automatically generate
• Executive Report & Technical Report
• Risk Score
• Threat Matrix
• AI Confidence Score
• Expected Solution/Deliverables:
• Working software prototype
• AI classification engine
• Interactive dashboard
• Security assessment report
• Demonstration video
• Technical documentation
• Dataset used for training/testing
summary: Innovation (3/5): draws on ai applied to a blockchain & cybersecurity problem, placing it in the moderate band. Feasibility (3/5): as a software build with moderate integration complexity, a full build is tight for 36 hours and will need scope-cutting. Impact (2/5): addresses a more targeted user group within Blockchain & Cybersecurity. Tech Depth (5/5): centers on encryption, algorithm, protocol. Sustainability (3/5): will need a maintenance/upkeep plan post-hackathon. Scalability (3/5): currently scoped narrowly and would need rework to scale. Total 19/30 -> Yellow verdict.

detail.title: AI-Powered IPsec VPN Protocol Analyzer and Security Assessment Framework

overview.in_plain_terms: Build a tool that analyzes captured IPsec VPN traffic and configurations to automatically identify weak cryptographic choices, key exchange problems, and misconfigurations, then gives clear, actionable security recommendations instead of requiring expert manual interpretation.
overview.why_it_matters: IPsec security depends on many interacting factors, cipher choice, key exchange method, mode, that only expert analysts can currently assess. Automating that expert interpretation makes IPsec security review accessible and scalable.
pain_points: IPsec security depends on many interacting factors (ciphers, key exchange, mode) that are easy to misconfigure.
Traditional protocol analysis tools give packet-level visibility but require expert interpretation.
No intelligent system automatically assesses risk and generates actionable recommendations for IPsec deployments.
overview.background: IPsec VPN security depends on correctly configuring many interacting cryptographic and protocol parameters, but current tools require expert manual interpretation rather than automated intelligent assessment.
overview.whats_being_asked: An AI-driven protocol analysis platform automatically analyzing IPsec VPN deployments under different security configurations, identifying characteristics, assessing risk, and generating recommendations.
expected_solution: Automated IPsec protocol/configuration identification from captured traffic.
Security risk assessment across cryptographic algorithms, key exchange, and mode.

analysis.innovation_scope_note: Moderate-High as scored. Similar profile to SIH26159, automated protocol security assessment beyond raw packet decoding is genuine, valuable analytical sophistication for a specific protocol.
analysis.invention_effort_note: Moderate-high. IPsec/IKE protocol parsing uses established techniques; genuine risk-assessment logic grounded in real IPsec security best practices is the real, valuable work.

competitive_landscape.note: Requires genuine network security/IPsec protocol expertise, a narrow, technical field similar to SIH26159.

innovation.note: Established protocol analysis pattern, value is in genuine automated risk assessment beyond raw decoding.

invention.note: IPsec/IKE parsing plus genuine security-assessment logic grounded in real best practices is substantial, specialized work.

technical_feasibility.note: You can set up your own IPsec VPN test deployments with various configurations to generate real test traffic.

impact_and_benefits.note: Directly improves IPsec deployment security review for enterprise/government/military contexts.

architecture.note: IPsec/IKE protocol parsing plus risk-assessment layer, well-understood pattern applied to this specific protocol.

overall_verdict.reasoning: Strong pick, genuinely achievable with self-generated test data. Set up multiple test IPsec configurations (some secure, some deliberately weak) to give your risk-assessment logic real, checkable ground truth.

evaluator_lens.biggest_strength: You can set up your own test IPsec VPN deployments with a range of configurations (secure and deliberately weak), giving concrete ground truth for validation.
evaluator_lens.biggest_risk: Building protocol identification without genuine, well-grounded security-assessment logic would miss the PS's actual differentiating ask, intelligent risk assessment, not just protocol decoding.
evaluator_lens.validate_before_commit: Set up multiple test IPsec configurations (a secure modern setup, and one or more deliberately weak configurations, e.g. outdated ciphers or weak key exchange) to validate your risk-assessment logic against known ground truth.

idea_0_4: Set up multiple test IPsec VPN configurations, at least one secure and one deliberately weak, to generate real test traffic.
Research real IPsec/IKE security best practices to ground your risk-assessment logic.
Split: one person on protocol parsing/identification, one on risk-assessment logic.
prototype_4_22: Build IPsec/IKE protocol parsing and configuration identification from captured traffic.
Build your risk-assessment logic grounded in real security best practices.
Test against your generated test configurations.
integration_22_30: Connect parsing and risk assessment into one coherent pipeline.
Test that your system correctly distinguishes your secure and deliberately weak test configurations.
polish_30_36: Polish the report for genuine analyst usability.
Rehearse a live demo analyzing both a secure and a weak test configuration, showing correctly differentiated assessments.
Prepare to discuss your risk-assessment methodology's grounding in real best practices.
build_plan.how_to_stand_out: Analyze both a genuinely secure and a genuinely weak IPsec configuration you set up yourself, live, and show your system correctly differentiating them with specific, actionable recommendations for the weak one, that ground-truth validation is concrete proof of real analytical capability.

strengths: You can generate real, controlled test data across multiple configurations.
Genuine value in automated risk assessment beyond raw protocol decoding.
weaknesses: Risk-assessment logic needs real grounding in current IPsec security best practices to be credible.
Real enterprise deployment diversity is broader than what you can construct for testing.

team_fit.ideal_ratio: Balanced, with real research into current IPsec security standards.
team_fit.approach: Set up your own test IPsec configurations first, this gives you concrete, controllable validation ground truth.

ai_buildability_split.ai_can_build_fast: Standard IKE/IPsec packet parsing using existing techniques and libraries.
ai_buildability_split.needs_human_judgment: Designing genuinely accurate risk-assessment logic grounded in real, current IPsec security best practices, that requires real domain expertise.
ai_buildability_split.risk_of_leaning_on_ai_only: An AI-generated risk-assessment system without grounding in real IPsec security standards could misassess genuine configuration risks.

data_resource_availability.status: You can generate your own realistic test IPsec traffic with self-configured VPN deployments, giving full control over ground truth.
data_resource_availability.backup_plan: Not needed, self-generated test configurations are the appropriate approach here.

judge_qna.question: How does your tool distinguish a secure IPsec configuration from a weak one, and what's it based on?
judge_qna.strong_answer: Walk through your specific risk-assessment criteria grounded in real IPsec security best practices, and demonstrate against your two test configurations.
judge_qna.follow_up: What's the most commonly overlooked IPsec misconfiguration your tool catches?

judge_qna.question: How does your tool handle Tunnel mode versus Transport mode differences in its analysis?
judge_qna.strong_answer: Describe how your assessment logic accounts for the different security implications of each mode.
judge_qna.follow_up: What key exchange method vulnerabilities does your tool specifically flag?
